text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Machan has realized.
In this Sengoku period of mascot characters,
just being cute isn't enough."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The strength to survive.
That's something a beloved character needs too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, time to observe Gentildonna-san.
Today she's doing tile breaking, I see. Staaaaare...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You may leave it be.
More importantly... shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Impressive. Truly astonishing.
The number of roof tiles broken was controlled perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why is that?
I believe the more power you have, the better."
choice_data_list: The greater the power, the harder it is to control.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, by undergoing this training,
Gentildonna will be able to attain
flawless control over her immense power, and—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Only one who can wield their power freely by their own will is truly strong!
—Ninety-nine tiles! Haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: ...All right, OK! That's gotten a whole lot steadier.
...All right, OK! That's looking much more stable now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
It's strangely delightful, you know. Your coaching, that is.
choice_data_list: I am honored that you are pleased.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... To care and be cared for. Oneself and others.
Is this the strength to survive?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohohohoho.
Now then, I wonder if you will be able to master it?
